items.source_en:
I had Iris do a post-mortem and analyze the hyperdrive system. According to her, the inferometer calibration is broken. None of the mappings are anywhere near the destination.

And that's the just for starters. Aleksy and Pete have been combing over the rest of the ship, and the news is grim. The collision with the asteroid caused a stress fracture to multiple exhaust pipes. A scan of the air quality shows high levels of ammonia and hydrogen chloride.

Some of the tools we'll need to do repairs have also been damaged, meaning our best option is to seal off the toxic areas and try to signal for help.

...Ok. That was cute. But you really need to come back IMMEDIATELY and give me my money.

You are lucky that I'm willing to let you live after that. If you don't pay me, or return the droid, I will kill you. I am not playing games.

- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -

Wooo! you got Toph-ed! you got Tofued!!!

You were all "Hello. Yes sir. Do you have the money, thank you, please." And I was like "Here's you're money! Bam bam bam!". Now I have Bruno. What are you gonna do, go to the Empire? Selling black market droids is illegal, idiot!
